lines.text: What if you invested just twenty dollars every month into Bitcoin, starting in twenty ten?
No big investments. No secret strategy. Just twenty dollars, month after month.
Back then, Bitcoin was worth pennies. Almost nobody imagined what would happen next.
As Bitcoin gained attention, prices exploded. But the journey was far from easy.
There were brutal crashes, market panic, and years when investors lost confidence.
Yet our imaginary investor never stopped. Every single month, another twenty dollars.
Fast-forward to November twenty twenty-six. After more than sixteen years of investing...
that three thousand, nine hundred forty dollars could have grown to somewhere between ninety-two and one hundred sixteen million dollars!
That's the power of starting early. But remember, Bitcoin's incredible past returns were never guaranteed.
